Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer at step 4 reported "Helsinki, Finland" as the birthplace based on Wikipedia and Born Glorious, but failed to cross-check with authoritative Swedish sources (SFdb, SBL) which later revealed conflicting data (Helsingborg).
